item.title: The Tavern Collective offers global comfort food in DFW
item.description: The Tavern Collective in Las Colinas offers a globally inspired comfort food, creative cocktails, arcade style fun, and a doggie bowl for furry friends in a steampunk-inspired atmosphere.

item.title: Pilot starts $1M fundraising campaign for heart association
item.description: Pilot has launched a fundraising campaign to support the American Heart Association and Heart & Stroke, with the goal of raising $1 million.

item.title: Garland's Art Made Here event highlights local artists
item.description: ART MADE HERE will take place in Garland, Texas on March 28, featuring an Art Fair, interactive crafts for kids, and live performances from local entertainment.

item.title: Z Dynasty Dance Company to perform at Granville Arts Center
item.description: The Z Dynasty Family Showcase will take place at the Granville Arts Center on Feb. 6, featuring dynamic performances by the Z Dynasty Dance Company and providing an intimate experience for the audience.

item.title: Disney's "Frozen" musical coming to Dallas
item.description: Family Music Theatre will present Disney's Frozen the Musical from Feb. 27 to March 14, 2026, at the New Vida Center in Dallas, Texas, featuring popular songs and a heartwarming story for audiences of all ages.

item.title: Omni PGA Frisco unveils SAVOR 2026: Food, golf, music fest
item.description: The Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa has announced the return of SAVOR, its signature celebration of food, drink, golf and music, scheduled from April 30 to May 3, 2026, featuring award-winning chefs, live entertainment, and immersive experiences, with proceeds benefiting the Boys & Girls Club of Collin County.

item.title: Hudson House opens in uptown Dallas' West Village
item.description: Vandelay Companies will open its 10th Hudson House location on Feb. 4, bringing a popular East Coast-inspired restaurant to Uptown Dallas' West Village with a diverse menu, inviting atmosphere, and happy hour specials.

item.title: Planet Fitness: Your ultimate destination for fitness goals
item.description: Planet Fitness is an accessible gym with locations across all 50 states, offering cardio and weight equipment, as well as amenities like massage chairs, tanning, and total body enhancement.

item.title: Milkshakes and more in Irving: A sweet treat for every craving
item.description: Milkshakes and More in Irving offers a variety of sweet treats, including boba teas, coffee, smoothies, slushies, ice cream desserts, and gourmet chocolate.

item.title: North Texas to stay above freezing overnight
item.description: North Texas is expected to stay above freezing overnight into Thursday morning, with temperatures in the mid 30s and clouds helping to keep temperatures from dropping too low.
